description: This file provides an emulation layer for the deprecated kses() function by substituting it with HTML Purifier. It initializes configuration for HTML purification based on allowed HTML elements, attributes, and protocols, and returns the purified HTML string.

methods.name: kses
methods.description: Emulates the deprecated kses() function by configuring HTML Purifier with specified allowed HTML elements, attributes, and protocols, and returning the purified HTML string.
